name: Malaysia National Conservation Trust Fund for Natural Resources (NCTF)

funder.name: Ministry of Natural Resources and Environmental Sustainability, Malaysia

summary: A national trust fund that pays for managing, monitoring and protecting biodiversity areas and species, plus research, capacity building and sustainable financing. Local NGOs, community organisations, research bodies and agencies can apply by email to the secretariat.
